name: TraPPE_UA polar liquids benchmark
description: Evaluates the TraPPE_UA force field performance on multiple thermophysical properties (density, heat of vaporization, dielectric constant, surface tension, volumetric expansion coefficient, isothermal compressibility) of polar liquids.
reputation: A targeted benchmark used within the molecular simulation / force-field validation community for assessing TraPPE_UA performance; moderately known among specialists.
notes: Evaluates classical force-field predictions of thermophysical properties; results are sensitive to simulation protocol and experimental reference data; small set of polar liquids — not an ML/LLM benchmark.
